content: Hello. I'd like a copy of the brochure, please. How much is that?
It's free. There's one map inside.
Oh. Thank you very much. Look, I'm only here for three days. What are the best places to see?
Well... There is a lot you could do. Are you interested in visiting some outlying islands such as Lantau?
Yes, there are a lot of interesting things you can see there; there are old villages and temples. And the scenery is very nice. This brochure tells you more. You could think about it.
Well... I will. Thanks very much indeed!
